capabilities: Move tasks between adjacent daily notes via an inline icon or commands
Move the whole task block including nested lists and embeds
Re-position tasks under the matching heading in the target note
Auto-create missing headings in the target note
Skip moves when the target note already contains the same task line
extras: The Obsidian marketplace listing carries an unreleased-plugin warning: 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.'
problem: Obsidian's daily notes have no built-in way to carry unfinished tasks over to another day while keeping their position under the original heading.

relations.evidence: The built-in "Daily notes" core plugin must be enabled: this plugin relies on its settings

summary: Task mover that shifts tasks with their sub-items from one daily note to the previous or next day, repositioning them under the same heading.
